name: QuantumBackpack Pro
description: A smart backpack with integrated solar panel, USB-C fast charging, and anti-theft RFID pockets. Ideal for digital nomads and daily commuters.

name: AuraSound Mini Speaker
description: Compact Bluetooth 5.3 speaker with 360° immersive audio, 20-hour battery life, and built-in voice assistant. Perfect for indoor and outdoor use.

name: ErgoGlide Mouse
description: Wireless ergonomic mouse with silent clicks, adjustable DPI up to 4000, and a rechargeable battery lasting 6 months on a single charge.

name: LuminaDesk Lamp
description: LED desk lamp with touch controls, 3 color temperatures, and built-in wireless charging pad for smartphones. Reduces eye strain with flicker-free light.

name: FitPulse Tracker
description: Health and fitness tracker with heart rate monitoring, SpO2 sensor, sleep analysis, and GPS. Syncs with iOS and Android via companion app.

name: ZenFlow Humidifier
description: Ultrasonic cool-mist humidifier with adjustable mist output, auto shut-off, and a 2.5L tank that runs up to 24 hours. Whisper-quiet operation for bedrooms and offices.

name: PulseCharge Power Bank
description: 20000mAh portable power bank with 65W USB-C PD output, fast-charging 3 devices simultaneously, and digital battery percentage display.

name: AeroFit Yoga Mat
description: Non-slip eco-friendly yoga mat with alignment lines, 6mm thickness for joint comfort, and moisture-wicking surface. Suitable for all yoga styles.

name: CrispView Monitor Arm
description: Full-motion gas spring monitor arm for screens up to 35", with USB ports, cable management, and clamp/grommet mounting options. Ergonomic height adjustment.

name: SonicClean Toothbrush
description: Sonic electric toothbrush with 4 cleaning modes, 2-minute timer, and 8 replacement heads. Waterproof and USB rechargeable, lasting 30 days per charge.
